rows.grounds: locative indicating scope of protection; sarva+gātra compound

items.question: Which goddess is invoked to protect all the devotee's limbs and receive homage?
premises: The devotee directly addresses Durgā, the goddess.
The devotee requests protection in all limbs.
The devotee offers homage to the addressed goddess.
items.inference: Durgā is the invoked deity from whom bodily protection and to whom reverence are directed.
items.plain_english: Protect me in all my limbs, O Durgā, O goddess; homage be to you.
